svg.metadata: {"kind":"president","years":[1996,2000,2004,2008,2012,2016,2020,2024],"yearA":2020,"yearB":2024,"county":"63000","wipe":3,"metric":"dpp","sourceVersion":"2026-11-02","sources":["https://www.moi.gov.tw/News_toggle3.aspx?n=174&sms=9015","https://www.ey.gov.tw/state/62879155A536D543/f3662cb7-5806-4755-8aba-ab1d44b97d7a","https://db.cec.gov.tw/ElecTable"],"method":"2010年前臺中、臺南、高雄縣市先加總票數與分母；臺北縣對應新北市、桃園縣對應桃園市；其餘保留官方縣市整體單位。沒有按面積或人口分攤。"}
